description: Single-file chess: full legal move generation with castling, en passant and promotion, check/checkmate/stalemate detection, threefold-repetition awareness, move list in algebraic notation, simple minimax AI opponent with material+position eval, board flip, localStorage save.

criteria: chess_model_01.html is one self-contained chess game (no libraries): legal move generation for all pieces including castling rights, en passant and promotion with a choice dialog, full check/checkmate/stalemate detection (no moves that leave the king in check), a move history rendered in standard algebraic notation with disambiguation, a simple AI opponent playing a minimax search at a fixed depth with material and positional evaluation that responds in reasonable time, board flip, undo, and game state persistence to localStorage. No illegal moves accepted; no hardcoded AI moves.
